author: Pavlo
body:
Hi guys,

Quite a few people release maps without any showing  vanilla images of their map. This post is just to make sure you guys know what images we need to judge a map properly and decide on whether or not to accept it. 

So, when releasing a map, please provide images:
- Without shaders
- With the default resource pack
- With the default FOV
- A clear overview of your map (Top down view)

This makes our job a lot easier, as we don't have to individually ask you guys to add these images.

Please note, you can use shaders and other resource packs to take screenshots, as long as you have some normal images.

Thanks!
